purpose: Compile modules/audio_processing and its required dependencies on macOS arm64 Release, outside the repo, and measure size. No playback, no microphone, no App or extension edits, no section 5 acoustic tests.

checkout.subject: Roll back transports without a separate blocking call

gn.targetOs: default empty (macOS host; target_os was not set to ios)

builds.note: Official single-target build. Order-only deps, including libaec3.a and source_set objects, were built with it.
Documented entry BuiltinAudioProcessingBuilder is not inside libaudio_processing.a.

builds.command: autoninja -C out/Release <172 archives and 194 source_set objects from the generated ninja linkdeps>
builds.note: ninja: no work to do. Those outputs were already built as dependencies of the static library.

libraries.note: Archives are thin (arflags -T). File bytes are the archive header, not the code. Member bytes are the .o files and include -g2 debug info.

link.inputs: size_main.o + 194 source_set .o + 172 .a + libc++.a + libc++abi.a + libclang_rt.osx.a + -framework Foundation

emptyMainSameLinkFlags.note: Same official ldflags and libc++/libc++abi/clang_rt/Foundation, no WebRTC objects. Difference from the AudioProcessing executable is 1443520 file bytes, or 1001728 after llvm-strip.

section61Answer: 体积不再是未找到。回答第 6.1 节的数是链上最小程序之后的可执行文件 1460400 字节（去掉符号和调试信息的副本 1018560 字节）。这不是已经打进 App 的增量。
problems: 官方文档的例子目标是 h264_depacketizer_fuzzer。ninja 短名 audio_processing 失败：unknown target "audio_processing"（real 2.56 s）。生成工程里的目标是 obj/modules/audio_processing/libaudio_processing.a。没有另写一套构建脚本。

libaudio_processing.a 的瘦归档只有 audio_processing_impl.o 和 gain_control_impl.o。AEC3、Abseil、rnnoise 权重是 source_set，不在这份 .a 里。第一次链接因此报 undefined symbol，开头是 rnnoise::kOutputDenseWeights，接着是 absl（ThrowStdLengthError、FastIntToBuffer、LogMessageFatal、Mutex::lock/unlock、Cord::operator=）。没有改 WebRTC 源码。补上官方 ninja linkdeps 里的 .o 和 .a 之后再链。

第二次链接只剩 undefined symbol: absl::debugging_internal::DemangleRustSymbolEncoding。原因是收集依赖时把名字里含 rust 的 C++ 文件也跳过了。demangle_rust.cc、decode_rust_punycode.cc、utf8_for_code_point.cc 是 Abseil 的 C++，ninja 显示已经编过。加进链接后成功。
官方依赖图里还有 Rust .rlib：audio_frame_api → rtp_packet_info → rtp_rtcp_format 的 corruption detection，以及整份 rust std。这次 AudioProcessing 入口的链接没有引用它们，没有编、没有链。若下一步链接报这些符号，再停下来报告，不改源码。
